summary: Smile Design has a strong team, a booking form and WhatsApp. Visible errors and missing proof on the page weaken trust right where patients decide.

findings.problem: The stats (Happy Client 0+, Years of Expertise 0+, Dental Services 0+) show zeros, and the section is repeated twice.
findings.cost: Zeros tell a patient the clinic has no track record, even though you have been operating for years.

findings.problem: The booking form says Enter Your Phone Nummber, has no email field and no confirmation message. The service dropdown lists 9 categories, but the cards show only a few.
findings.cost: A visible typo and an unclear confirmation make patients unsure their request was received.
findings.fix: A clean form with a clear confirmation and services that match.

findings.problem: The reviews have no names, dates or ratings, and one mentions Dr. Meral, who is not on your doctor list. Before and after photos have only file names for captions.
findings.cost: Unattributed reviews and uncaptioned results do not persuade patients who compare clinics.
findings.fix: Named, dated reviews and captioned before and after cases with consent.

findings.problem: The Digital X-Ray heading sits above text about Digital Smile Design. Several links go to #, and Dr. Ihsan's bio appears in Arabic only on the English page.
findings.cost: Mismatched headings and dead links make the page look unfinished to an international or bilingual patient.
findings.fix: Correct headings, working links and consistent bilingual content.

redesign: A proof first homepage with real numbers, named reviews and captioned smile design cases beside every booking button.
One clear booking path with confirmation, plus WhatsApp on every page.
Treatment pages in Arabic and English written to rank for searches like smile makeover Riyadh.
